issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict accepts negative id values without validation

approach.summary: Add validation in Todo.from_dict to reject negative id values with a clear error message

verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/todo.py tests/test_issue_2000_json_validation.py

risks.notes: Only rejects invalid data that should never have been accepted. Valid non-negative IDs are unaffected.

implementation_details.validation_logic: After converting id to integer, check if todo_id < 0 and raise ValueError with clear message
implementation_details.error_message: Invalid value for 'id': {todo_id}. 'id' must be a non-negative integer.
